definitions.explanation: The front part of the body between the chest and hips. Most commonly used when talking about hunger or stomach-related feelings.

examples.japanese: お{腹|なか}が{空|す}きました。
examples.notes: The most common way to express hunger in Japanese

examples.japanese: お{腹|なか}がいっぱいです。
お{腹|なか}が{痛|いた}いです。
お{腹|なか}が{空|す}いたら、{何|なに}か{食|た}べましょう。
examples.english: If you get hungry, let's eat something.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんのお{腹|なか}はやわらかい。

notes: お{腹|なか} always includes the polite prefix お. The bare form {腹|はら} exists but sounds rough or masculine. お{腹|なか}が{空|す}く (to get hungry) and お{腹|なか}がいっぱい (to be full) are essential everyday expressions.
